author: pritampalit
body:
JetImpactParameters threw std::runtime_error whenever an output was not finite, which aborted the whole job. For a badly measured track, dxyError()/dzError() for can be inf. This was crashing on samples like displaced tau, QCD_MuEnriched etc. This is taken care of now : such values are replaced by a sentinel (-9999.0) with a warning instead of throwing, "Not filled" default values are shifted from -1 -> -9999.0.

Backport to CMSSW_16_0_X is opened in parallel for the 16_0_9 build.
title: Crash at non-finite jet impact parameter uncertainties is fixed.
